{
  "decision-close-the-tile-frame": "SELECT a.tile_id AS tile_1, b.tile_id AS tile_2, c.tile_id AS tile_3, d.tile_id AS tile_4
FROM edge_tiles AS a
JOIN edge_tiles AS b ON a.tile_id < b.tile_id
JOIN edge_tiles AS c ON b.tile_id < c.tile_id
JOIN edge_tiles AS d ON c.tile_id < d.tile_id
WHERE a.length_cm + b.length_cm + c.length_cm + d.length_cm = 12
  AND ((a.length_cm = b.length_cm AND c.length_cm = d.length_cm)
    OR (a.length_cm = c.length_cm AND b.length_cm = d.length_cm)
    OR (a.length_cm = d.length_cm AND b.length_cm = c.length_cm))
ORDER BY tile_1, tile_2, tile_3, tile_4
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-coating-yield-at-contract-mix": "WITH RECURSIVE pooled AS (
  SELECT finish_code,
         SUM(good_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'baseline') AS bg,
         SUM(fed_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'baseline') AS bf,
         SUM(good_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'trial') AS tg,
         SUM(fed_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'trial') AS tf
  FROM coating_run GROUP BY finish_code
), terms AS (
  SELECT m.contract_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.contract_code ORDER BY m.finish_code) AS pos,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.contract_code) AS total,
         100 * m.mix_pct * (p.tg * p.bf - p.bg * p.tf) AS num,
         p.tf * p.bf AS den, p.bf > 0 AND p.tf > 0 AS valid
  FROM contract_mix AS m LEFT JOIN pooled AS p USING (finish_code)
), acc(contract_code, pos, total, num, den) AS (
  SELECT contract_code, pos, total, num, den FROM terms WHERE pos = 1 AND valid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.contract_code, t.pos, t.total, a.num * t.den + t.num * a.den, a.den * t.den
  FROM acc AS a JOIN terms AS t ON t.contract_code = a.contract_code AND t.pos = a.pos + 1
  WHERE t.valid
)
SELECT contract_code, num / den + CASE WHEN ABS(num % den) >= den / 2 + den % 2 THEN CASE WHEN num < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END AS change_bp
FROM acc WHERE pos = total ORDER BY contract_code",
  "decision-collapse-color-components": "WITH RECURSIVE edges(src, dst) AS (
  SELECT left_code, right_code FROM color_links
  UNION SELECT right_code, left_code FROM color_links
), reachable(sample_code, member) AS (
  SELECT sample_code, sample_code FROM samples
  UNION
  SELECT r.sample_code, e.dst FROM reachable AS r JOIN edges AS e ON e.src = r.member COLLATE BINARY
)
SELECT sample_code, MIN(member COLLATE BINARY) AS representative_code
FROM reachable GROUP BY sample_code COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY sample_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-commit-a-kiln-cooldown-before-orders-settle": "WITH regrets AS (
  SELECT estimate_id, crew_hours,
         tile_cents - MIN(tile_cents) OVER () AS tile_regret_cents,
         brick_cents - MIN(brick_cents) OVER () AS brick_regret_cents
  FROM kiln_estimate WHERE crew_hours <= (SELECT allowed_hours FROM crew_roster)
)
SELECT estimate_id, tile_regret_cents, brick_regret_cents,
       MAX(tile_regret_cents, brick_regret_cents) AS worst_regret_cents
FROM regrets ORDER BY worst_regret_cents, crew_hours, estimate_id COLLATE BINARY LIMIT 1"
}

FROM edge_tiles AS a
JOIN edge_tiles AS b ON a.tile_id < b.tile_id
JOIN edge_tiles AS c ON b.tile_id < c.tile_id
JOIN edge_tiles AS d ON c.tile_id < d.tile_id
WHERE a.length_cm + b.length_cm + c.length_cm + d.length_cm = 12
  AND ((a.length_cm = b.length_cm AND c.length_cm = d.length_cm)
    OR (a.length_cm = c.length_cm AND b.length_cm = d.length_cm)
    OR (a.length_cm = d.length_cm AND b.length_cm = c.length_cm))
ORDER BY tile_1, tile_2, tile_3, tile_4
LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE pooled AS (
  SELECT finish_code,
         SUM(good_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'baseline') AS bg,
         SUM(fed_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'baseline') AS bf,
         SUM(good_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'trial') AS tg,
         SUM(fed_pcs) FILTER (WHERE phase_code = 'trial') AS tf
  FROM coating_run GROUP BY finish_code
), terms AS (
  SELECT m.contract_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.contract_code ORDER BY m.finish_code) AS pos,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.contract_code) AS total,
         100 * m.mix_pct * (p.tg * p.bf - p.bg * p.tf) AS num,
         p.tf * p.bf AS den, p.bf > 0 AND p.tf > 0 AS valid
  FROM contract_mix AS m LEFT JOIN pooled AS p USING (finish_code)
), acc(contract_code, pos, total, num, den) AS (
  SELECT contract_code, pos, total, num, den FROM terms WHERE pos = 1 AND valid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.contract_code, t.pos, t.total, a.num * t.den + t.num * a.den, a.den * t.den
  FROM acc AS a JOIN terms AS t ON t.contract_code = a.contract_code AND t.pos = a.pos + 1
  WHERE t.valid
)
SELECT contract_code, num / den + CASE WHEN ABS(num % den) >= den / 2 + den % 2 THEN CASE WHEN num < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END AS change_bp
FROM acc WHERE pos = total ORDER BY contract_code
